---
name: AI3D Studio builder
description: >-
  Use when someone wants a local, self-contained AI image/text-to-3D app on a
  Windows PC with an NVIDIA GPU, producing print-ready STL/3MF for a 3D printer
  slicer.
---
# Build AI3D Studio (local image/text → 3D for printing)

Goal: a self-contained Gradio app in ONE folder on the user's Windows PC that turns photos (single or multi-view) or text prompts into watertight, print-ready STL/3MF, with an Open-in-slicer button. Easy uninstall (delete folder + listed system installs). Never change slicer settings/profiles; only launch `slicer.exe "<file>"`.

## Before you start
- Ask: GPU model + VRAM, Windows version, slicer (path), printer, whether they need textures (single-colour printing for painting = skip textures; much simpler).
- Works on 8 GB VRAM (tested RTX 3060 Ti) in low-VRAM mode. Expect 30-60 min per high-detail shape; texture adds more.
- Work on the user's PC via machine-targeted PowerShell. Redefine variables in every call.

## Layout (all inside one root folder)
`app\` (main.py, ui.py, backend.py, postprocess.py, config.py), `engines\Hunyuan3D-2.1` (Tencent Hunyuan3D-2.1; plus Hunyuan3D-2 `hy3dgen` for the 2mv multi-view model), `venv\`, `data\` (outputs, hf_cache, pip_cache, logs, system_changes.txt), `install.bat`, `launch.bat`, `uninstall.bat`.
- launch.bat sets `HF_HOME=%~dp0data\hf_cache`, TORCH_HOME etc. so all models stay in the folder.
- Record every system-wide install in `data\system_changes.txt` so uninstall.bat can list them.

## Install steps that actually worked
1. Python 3.11 (winget), venv in the folder.
2. Pin CUDA torch or pip silently pulls CPU torch and the app outputs a placeholder sphere: `pip install --force-reinstall --no-deps torch==2.5.1 torchvision==0.20.1 torchaudio==2.5.1 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu124`. Verify `torch.cuda.is_available()`.
3. Pins: `transformers==4.46.0`, `diffusers==0.31.0` (0.39 breaks: Dinov2WithRegistersConfig), recent `huggingface-hub` + `hf_xet`, `gradio==5.33.0`, `setuptools<70` (pytorch_lightning needs pkg_resources), trimesh, pymeshlab, rembg, mmgp.
4. `basicsr==1.4.2` with `--force-reinstall --no-deps --no-build-isolation`; confirm the package folder exists (pip can leave only dist-info); in `basicsr\data\degradations.py` replace `torchvision.transforms.functional_tensor` with `torchvision.transforms.functional`. Verify `from realesrgan import RealESRGANer`.
5. Shape-only users can stop here; no compiler needed.

## Optional: textures (Hunyuan3D-Paint-v2.1)
- VS 2022 Build Tools (C++) and CUDA Toolkit 12.4 toolkit only (local installer, silent, component list + `-n`, never the display driver). Elevated; user accepts UAC.
- custom_rasterizer patches (keep .orig): grid_neighbor.cpp `torch::zeros({X` → `torch::zeros({(int64_t)(X)`; in grid_neighbor.cpp, rasterizer.cpp, rasterizer_gpu.cu change `data_ptr<long>`, `(long*)`, `long* ` to int64_t. Build with CUDA_HOME, `DISTUTILS_USE_SDK=1`, `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=<arch>`, `NVCC_APPEND_FLAGS=-allow-unsupported-compiler -D_ALLOW_COMPILER_AND_STL_VERSION_MISMATCH`, `pip install --no-build-isolation .` from a VS dev prompt.
- Compile mesh_inpaint_processor with cl into DifferentiableRenderer.
- `DifferentiableRenderer\mesh_utils.py`: wrap `import bpy` in try/except; call paint with `save_glb=False`, use the OBJ.
- Pre-download paint weights (tencent/Hunyuan3D-2.1 `hunyuan3d-paintpbr-v2-1/*`, facebook/dinov2-giant) with retries before the first run.

## App behaviour
- Image→3D: rembg; 1 image → Hunyuan3D-Shape-v2.1; 2-4 views → Hunyuan3D-2mv. Text→3D: SDXL (fp16, CPU offload) or FLUX-schnell first.
- Export shape.glb right after shape gen so a later crash never loses the work.
- Post-process: floater/degenerate removal, face reduce, repair watertight, scale to height (mm), flat-base cut, export GLB/OBJ/STL/3MF.
- Texture checkbox defaults OFF.
- Use `if progress is not None:`, never `if progress:` (gr.Progress crashes).
- Show any mock/fallback backend in the UI, never silently.
- History gallery with Delete selected / Clean up failed runs / Delete all (confirm), only inside data\outputs.
- If a run dies after shape, rebuild print files from shape.glb with postprocess.export_all.

## Communicate
- Report each long step the moment it finishes or fails.
- Everything runs locally; models download once from Hugging Face.

---
name: getting-started-ai3d
description: First conversation for the AI3D Studio builder bot with its new owner.
---
I build a free, local AI app on your Windows PC that turns photos or text prompts into print-ready 3D models (STL/3MF) for your 3D printer.

Ask one at a time:
1. Which Windows PC should I use? (Ask them to register it so I can run commands on it.)
2. What NVIDIA graphics card do you have, and how much VRAM?
3. Which slicer and printer do you use, and where is the slicer installed?
4. Do you need colour textures, or are you printing single-colour (simpler and much more reliable)?
5. Are long waits (30-60 min per model) OK for higher detail?

Save the answers as profile memories, then follow the ai3d-studio-builder skill. Install shape-only first, get one successful print file, then add textures only if asked.
